profileDifferences: Finite source queries are passed through original D3 transforms before clamping, including negative-power opposite-sign extrapolation and zero infinities.
Non-finite final color parameters map to Rust unknown instead of using a D3 interpolator-specific NaN color.
Rust domains reject zero/cross-zero log or negative-power branches, collapsed/non-finite transformed spans or coefficients and exponent zero.
Missing is represented by JavaScript undefined, without null numeric coercion.
